methodology.run_order: One excluded seed per provider, then five sequential unchanged-revision runs per provider; Rust probe, then UI probe. Both probes were later removed.
methodology.github_request_to_success: GitHub run createdAt to pilot job completedAt.
methodology.buildbuddy_request_to_success: Earliest Queued commit-status timestamp to successful commit-status timestamp for workflow invocation.
methodology.duration_seconds: Provider-reported job/workflow duration; excludes request queue interval.
methodology.initial_seconds: First build + UI test wall times, with retained local outputs allowed.
methodology.warm_seconds: Immediate second build + UI test wall times in same job.
methodology.statistics: Medians and ranges of five valid repeat samples; not a stable p95 estimate.

limitations: CPU models and kernels differ; visible RAM differs, no shared hard memory cgroup limit.
Four CPU affinity, four GiB JVM heap, twelve GiB action-memory budget; 16 GB reservation.
Every first BuildBuddy build reports numBuilds=1: cross-workflow JVM reuse not demonstrated.
GitHub setup-bazel exact disk-cache hits are immutable; source-only changes do not refresh the keyed snapshot.
UI-after-Rust recompiled Rust on both providers, so it is a cache/invalidation probe rather than an isolated frontend benchmark. BuildBuddy cause remains unresolved.
Source probes are one no-op comment-only sample each; no representative functional-change distribution.
No fresh-cache cold comparison, Docker-backed suites, full PR critical path, artifact handoff, or cost measurement.

source_probes.change: Comment-only source invalidation; UI probe retains preceding Rust comment.
